_doc: Evaluation suite for the charter-critic (T2.5; case design in the T2.5 row of the build plan). Synthetic, domain-neutral charters for four made-up problems (library returns, volunteer shift swaps, a bike-repair queue, community-hall bookings). Each case gives the owner's answers (the brief as A01, then each answer round) and the charter under review. Rule 8 pairs: S1 (P16/C08) and S2 (P17/C09).
revision: Revised after first run (quick pass 2026-11-03): shared domain-base defects fixed in the cases, approver_role schema fact and the CH09/CV01-CV04 boundary added to the rulebook. Revision 2 after quick pass 2 (2026-11-04): rule-by-rule audit of all four bases, allowed data classes in the rulebook (lint-checked). Revision 3 after quick pass 3 (2026-11-05): class order, factory caps and the output-field definition in the rulebook; K01 and K16 reworked where the plant was arguable; three missed base defects fixed; critic instructions tuned (field-by-field check, CH09 boundary, CH14/CH15 scope). Revision 4 after quick pass 4 (2026-11-05): K29 reworked where the CH04 plant was arguable; K05 key expects CH11 only; bike refusals say where a refused form goes; K10/K27 AC01 given a verb; rulebook: examples judged on content, CH09 boundary in its own row, schema field names never CH14. Revision 5 after quick pass 5 (2026-11-05): library reserve-shelf targets limited to undamaged books; bike inputs gain a drop-off date (K19), output order reads 'queue order'; glossary entries for training and role (volunteer base) and bench time (bike base). Frozen from pass 6: a case changes only for a gate miss or a defect proven by the rule text. Revision 6 after quick pass 6 (2026-11-10), rule-proven fixes plus an audit of every sentence changed in revisions 2-6: bike rows 'per accepted drop-off form'; K15/K22 courier rows have no decision and a part-returned group loan's decision is an open question; library inputs identify every refused item; library Q01 'whose reservation flag is set'. See the build log.
